# Tablow

> Tablow is an Indian healthcare aggregator. For a prescribed medicine it recommends one branded substitute with the exact same salt, strength and dosage form, shows the price per unit of both, and fulfils orders through licensed pharmacy partners. Tablow does not give medical advice.

## Substitutes
- [Augmentin 625 Duo Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/augmentin-625-duo-tablet) -> [Amoxyclav 625 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/amoxyclav-625-tablet): Amoxicillin 500 mg + Clavulanic Acid 125 mg, 37% cheaper (₹12.30 vs ₹19.66 per tablet)
- [Pan 20 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/pan-20-tablet) -> [Pantop 20 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/pantop-20-tablet): Pantoprazole 20 mg, 32% cheaper (₹6.60 vs ₹9.67 per tablet)
- [Pan 40 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/pan-40-tablet) -> [Pantop 40 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/pantop-40-tablet): Pantoprazole 40 mg, 28% cheaper (₹10.80 vs ₹15.03 per tablet)
- [Glycomet GP 1 Tablet SR](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/glycomet-gp-1-tablet) -> [Glimisave M1 Tablet SR](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/glimisave-m1-tablet): Glimepiride 1 mg + Metformin 500 mg, 20% cheaper (₹6.40 vs ₹8.00 per tablet)
- [Glycomet GP 2 Tablet SR](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/glycomet-gp-2-tablet) -> [Glimisave M2 Tablet SR](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/glimisave-m2-tablet): Glimepiride 2 mg + Metformin 500 mg, 23% cheaper (₹9.40 vs ₹12.13 per tablet)
- [Foracort 200 Inhaler](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/foracort-200-inhaler) -> [Budamate 200 Inhaler](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/budamate-200-inhaler): Budesonide 200 mcg + Formoterol 6 mcg per puff, 19% cheaper (₹4.12 vs ₹5.08 per dose)
- [Foracort 400 Inhaler](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/foracort-400-inhaler) -> [Budamate 400 Inhaler](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/budamate-400-inhaler): Budesonide 400 mcg + Formoterol 6 mcg per puff, 19% cheaper (₹5.33 vs ₹6.58 per dose)
- [Mixtard 30/70 40IU/ml Injection](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/mixtard-30-70-40iu-injection) -> [Insugen 30/70 40IU/ml Injection](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/insugen-30-70-40iu-injection): Human insulin 30% soluble + 70% isophane, 40 IU/ml, 16% cheaper (₹150.00 vs ₹178.00 per vial)
- [Dolo 650 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/dolo-650-tablet) -> [Pacimol 650 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/pacimol-650-tablet): Paracetamol 650 mg, 29% cheaper (₹1.60 vs ₹2.24 per tablet)
- [Telma 40 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/telma-40-tablet) -> [Telmikind 40 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/telmikind-40-tablet): Telmisartan 40 mg, 59% cheaper (₹6.60 vs ₹16.00 per tablet)
- [Telma 80 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/telma-80-tablet) -> [Telmikind 80 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/telmikind-80-tablet): Telmisartan 80 mg, 57% cheaper (₹9.80 vs ₹22.80 per tablet)
- [Thyronorm 25 mcg Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyronorm-25-mcg-tablet) -> [Thyrox 25 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyrox-25-tablet): Levothyroxine 25 mcg, 20% cheaper (₹1.07 vs ₹1.33 per tablet)
- [Thyronorm 50 mcg Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyronorm-50-mcg-tablet) -> [Thyrox 50 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyrox-50-tablet): Levothyroxine 50 mcg, 21% cheaper (₹1.30 vs ₹1.65 per tablet)
- [Thyronorm 100 mcg Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyronorm-100-mcg-tablet) -> [Thyrox 100 Tablet](https://www.tablow.in/medicines/thyrox-100-tablet): Levothyroxine 100 mcg, 20% cheaper (₹1.57 vs ₹1.97 per tablet)
